title: 1931: A Glance at the Twentieth Century
sourceTitle: 1931: A Glance at the Twentieth Century
author: Henry Hartshorne
description: "1931: A Glance at the Twentieth Century" by Henry Hartshorne is a speculative diary-format book written in the late 19th century that presents a fictional account of the future as perceived from the year 1881.
longDescription: The text explores various sociopolitical, cultural, and technological changes that Hartshorne imagines will occur by 1931, delving into themes like governance, social equity, and public health.

authorInfo.bio: Henry Hartshorne (1823–1897) wrote 1931: A Glance at the Twentieth Century. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
